Your goal is to write programs that accomplish the tasks specified by the user.
This is a domain-specific language for regular expressions that specify string transformations.

Write programs using the available functions:

regex_split :: tsubstr -> tfullstr -> list(tsubstr)

regex_flatten :: list(tsubstr) -> tfullstr

regex_append :: t0 -> list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_reverse_cdr :: list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_cons :: t0 -> list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_car :: list(t0) -> t0

regex_cdr :: list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_map :: (t0 -> t1) -> list(t0) -> list(t1)

replace_if_match_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $1 $0) $2 $0)) (regex_split '.' $2))))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string if it matches a certain pattern, then splits the string by a delimiter.

replace_concat_cdr_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $2)))))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string with a concatenated version, then takes the cdr of the string split by a delimiter.

replace_end_with_substr :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a full string with a specified substring after splitting the string by a delimiter.

replace_with_transformed_substr :: tfullstr -> (tsubstr -> tsubstr) -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map $0 (regex_split '.' $1)))))
description: A function that replaces substrings in a full string with transformed versions based on a provided transformation function.

append_substr_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: A function that appends a substring to the end of a full string after splitting the string by an empty string.

replace_p_with_substring :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match 'p' $0) $1 $0)) (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: A function that replaces occurrences of 'p' in a full string with a specified substring after splitting the string by an empty string.

replace_if_match_concat :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match_split $0 (regex_concat 'a' $1) $2))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string with a concatenated version if it matches a certain pattern.

replace_first_letter_with_b :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons $0 (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the first letter of a full string with the letter 'b' after splitting the string by a delimiter.

replace_if_match_transformed_substr :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_with_transformed_substr $0 (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $0 $2) $3 $0))))))
description: A function that replaces substrings in a full string with a transformed version based on a provided condition.

replace_if_match_concat_with_c :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match_split $0 (regex_concat 'c' $1) $2))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string with a concatenated version if it matches a certain pattern, where the replacement substring is prefixed with 'c'.
